 Advertisement Russ Reed Maine election results: Races in Androscoggin, Franklin, Kennebec and Oxford counties
 Russ Reed Election night has arrived and in addition to the major races in Maine, Maine's Total Coverage is tracking dozens of local races.
 You can see results for communities in Androscoggin, Franklin, Kennebec, Oxford and York counties below and check results for other state and local races we are tracking.
